name: factory-band
description: Experimental. A band above the prompt for a factory run: each worker's worktree state, model and effort, belt denies and parked questions, and a weave now button.

events.title: Read the events service
events.description: Ask the local events service for belt's ledger (auto-mode denials, effort) and inbox (parked questions). Off counts belt's guard denials only and shows parked as a dash.

contractGuard.title: Contract guard
contractGuard.description: Deny a factory worker spawn whose prompt does not open with the eight-line task header. Off by default; belt stays the guard.
